description: Find US tariff lines (8-digit HTSUS codes) by product words or the start of a code, from the official HTSUS descriptions. Use it to get a code for us_tariff_check. A search hit is a candidate, not a classification ruling.

query.description: Product words or the start of a code, e.g. "cotton t-shirt" or "6109".

name: hts_search
title: Search HTSUS lines
